-- What a client importing `Proof.sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Defs` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def smd.Schema.resolveRef (S : smd.Schema) : Option smd.TypeRef → Option smd.Atom :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => none
  | some t => S.find t.name

def (sealed) smd.isFields : List sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.StructField → List
    (GoString × smd.TypeRef) → IProp GF

structure smd.Schema : Type where
  types : List (GoString × smd.Atom)

def smd.fieldType (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (elem : Option smd.TypeRef) (k : GoString) :
    Option smd.TypeRef :=
  match smd.lookupKV k fs with
  | some t => some t
  | none => elem

def smd.Scalar.goName : smd.Scalar → GoString :=
  match x✝ with
  | smd.Scalar.numeric => go!"numeric"
  | smd.Scalar.string => go!"string"
  | smd.Scalar.boolean => go!"boolean"
  | smd.Scalar.untyped => go!"untyped"

def (sealed) smd.schemaRep (fresh : Bool) (sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) : IProp GF

def smd.Atom.wf (S : smd.Schema) : smd.Atom → Bool :=
  match x✝ with
  | smd.Atom.scalar s => true
  | smd.Atom.list e rel ks =>
    S.resolves e &&
      (decide (rel = smd.ElemRel.atomic) ||
        decide (rel = smd.ElemRel.associative) && !ks.isEmpty && decide ks.Nodup &&
          match S.find e.name with
          | some (smd.Atom.map fs elem rel) => ks.all (smd.keyFieldOk S fs)
          | x => false)
  | smd.Atom.map fs e rel =>
    (decide (List.map (fun x => x.fst) fs).Nodup && fs.all fun f => S.resolves f.snd) &&
      match e with
      | some t => S.resolves t
      | none => true

inductive smd.Atom : Type
  | smd.Atom.scalar (s : smd.Scalar) : smd.Atom
  | smd.Atom.list (elem : smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel) (keys : List GoString) : smd.Atom
  | smd.Atom.map (fields : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (elem : Option smd.TypeRef) (rel :
      smd.ElemRel) : smd.Atom

def smd.instDecidableEqElemRel : DecidableEq smd.ElemRel :=
  if h : x✝.ctorIdx = y✝.ctorIdx then isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯

def smd.instInhabitedTypeRef : Inhabited smd.TypeRef :=
  { default := smd.instInhabitedTypeRef.default }

def (sealed) smd.isAtom (fresh : Bool) (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom) :
    smd.Atom → IProp GF

def smd.instDecidableEqTypeRef.decEq (x✝ x✝¹ : smd.TypeRef) : Decidable (x✝ = x✝¹) :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | { name := a, nullable := a_1 }, { name := b, nullable := b_1 } =>
    if h : a = b then h ▸ if h : a_1 = b_1 then h ▸ isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯ else isFalse ⋯

def (sealed) smd.freshSchema (sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) : IProp GF

def (sealed) smd.lastNamed {α : Type} (name : α → GoString) (n : GoString) (xs : List α) : Option α

def smd.keyFieldOk (S : smd.Schema) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (k : GoString) : Bool :=
  match smd.lookupKV k fs with
  | some kt =>
    match S.find kt.name with
    | some (smd.Atom.scalar s) => true
    | x => false
  | none => false

def smd.Schema.find (S : smd.Schema) (n : GoString) : Option smd.Atom :=
  smd.lookupKV n S.types

def (sealed) smd.mapRep (fresh : Bool) (m : Loc) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (e : Option
    smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel) : IProp GF

def (sealed) smd.isListRep (l : Loc) (e : smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel) (ks : List GoString) :
    IProp GF

def (sealed) smd.freshAtom (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom) (A : smd.Atom) :
    IProp GF

def (sealed) smd.lazyIndex {T : Type} [ZeroVal T] (fresh : Bool) (o u : Loc) (ok : GMap GoString T →
    Prop) : IProp GF

def (sealed) smd.isTypeRef (tr : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.TypeRef) (t :
    smd.TypeRef) : IProp GF

def (sealed) smd.atomZero (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom) : Prop

def smd.instDecidableEqTypeRef : DecidableEq smd.TypeRef :=
  smd.instDecidableEqTypeRef.decEq

inductive smd.ElemRel : Type
  | smd.ElemRel.atomic : smd.ElemRel
  | smd.ElemRel.associative : smd.ElemRel
  | smd.ElemRel.separable : smd.ElemRel
  | smd.ElemRel.unset : smd.ElemRel

def (sealed) smd.isAtomOpt (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom) : Option smd.Atom
    → IProp GF

structure smd.TypeRef : Type where
  name : GoString
  nullable : Bool

theorem smd.ElemRel.ofNat_ctorIdx (x : smd.ElemRel) : smd.ElemRel.ofNat x.ctorIdx = x

def smd.Schema.resolvesRef (S : smd.Schema) : Option smd.TypeRef → Bool :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => true
  | some t => S.resolves t

def smd.instInhabitedElemRel.default : smd.ElemRel :=
  smd.ElemRel.atomic

def smd.Scalar.ofNat : Nat → smd.Scalar :=
  bif n.ble 1 then bif n.ble 0 then smd.Scalar.numeric else smd.Scalar.string
  else bif n.ble 2 then smd.Scalar.boolean else smd.Scalar.untyped

def smd.instDecidableWF (S : smd.Schema) : Decidable S.WF :=
  smd.instDecidableWF._aux_1 S

    GoString × smd.TypeRef) : IProp GF

  { default := smd.instInhabitedAtom.default }

  | smd.Scalar.numeric : smd.Scalar
  | smd.Scalar.string : smd.Scalar
  | smd.Scalar.boolean : smd.Scalar
  | smd.Scalar.untyped : smd.Scalar

def smd.instInhabitedElemRel : Inhabited smd.ElemRel :=
  { default := smd.instInhabitedElemRel.default }

def smd.Schema.WF (S : smd.Schema) : Prop :=
  (decide (List.map (fun x => x.fst) S.types).Nodup &&
        !(List.map (fun x => x.fst) S.types).contains
            go!"__untyped_deduced_" &&
      S.types.all fun na => smd.Atom.wf S na.snd) =
    true

def (sealed) smd.isSchema (sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) : IProp GF

def smd.instInhabitedScalar : Inhabited smd.Scalar :=
  { default := smd.instInhabitedScalar.default }

theorem smd.Scalar.ofNat_ctorIdx (x : smd.Scalar) : smd.Scalar.ofNat x.ctorIdx = x

def smd.ElemRel.ofNat : Nat → smd.ElemRel :=
  bif n.ble 1 then bif n.ble 0 then smd.ElemRel.atomic else smd.ElemRel.associative
  else bif n.ble 2 then smd.ElemRel.separable else smd.ElemRel.unset

def smd.instInhabitedAtom.default : smd.Atom :=
  smd.Atom.scalar default

def smd.instDecidableEqScalar : DecidableEq smd.Scalar :=
  if h : x✝.ctorIdx = y✝.ctorIdx then isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯

def smd.instInhabitedScalar.default : smd.Scalar :=
  smd.Scalar.numeric

def smd.instInhabitedSchema.default : smd.Schema :=
  { types := default }

def (sealed) smd.isTypeDefs (fresh : Bool) : List
    sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.TypeDef → List (GoString × smd.Atom) → IProp GF

def smd.ElemRel.goName : smd.ElemRel → GoString :=
  match x✝ with
  | smd.ElemRel.atomic => go!"atomic"
  | smd.ElemRel.associative => go!"associative"
  | smd.ElemRel.separable => go!"separable"
  | smd.ElemRel.unset => []

def smd.Schema.resolves (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) : Bool :=
  (S.find t.name).isSome

def smd.instInhabitedTypeRef.default : smd.TypeRef :=
  { name := default }
